title: Lena and the Aftermath
author: Sable Blackwood
blurb: Jude Hartwell, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
